items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...did Kenny Clarke make those with you or Wally Bishop. Wally Bishop is on some of those...

ctx.x: Well, they were different than any recordings that I had been making. The versatility of the performance. I was in awe, as far as versatility was concerned. The rhythm section just had to be a (inaudible) one. A Ray Brown or Oscar Pettiford. (Unaudible)
Well, I guess, did Kenny Clarke make those with you or Wally Bishop. Wally Bishop is on some of those and Kenny Clarke is on some of the others.
Kenny Clarke was on some of them and I think, yeah, basically Kenny.
